resolution.note: context-gauge advisories capped at 150k/200k of the 400k window (advisoriesOf); test pins thresholds; confirm with token-scan.py on later sessions

title: Hand off before lead context passes 150k tokens
body:
Outcome: lead sessions hand off before per-turn context passes 150k tokens, so no lead turn above 150k remains in new sessions.
Why: turns above 150k context cost 558M tokens, 35% of all lead cache_read since 2026-11-01, in 52 of 216 sessions; the context-gauge advisory at 60% of autoCompactWindow 400000 (240k) fired in only 21 sessions, at median turn 157 (.krn/runs/roadmap-refill/token-per-slice.md, sections 6-7).
Proof: rerun .krn/runs/roadmap-refill/token-scan.py on sessions after the change; a test pins the new advisory threshold; startup cost per fresh session (median 13k cache_creation) stays counted against the saving.
Scope: .claude/settings.json autoCompactWindow or the context-gauge thresholds, krn-lead skill text, their tests.
